desktop.notes: Added alphabetical (A-Z and Z-A) title sorting controls across Movies and Series views with seamless reset to default catalog order.

android.notes: Added 3.5s hold threshold for favourites with confirmation dialog on removal; fixed channel sheet D-pad navigation and channel change without losing focus; added built-in remote-navigable on-screen keyboard in Search; added category filter chips and A-Z/Z-A sorting across Movies and Series; preserved search query and results on back navigation; and resolved Live TV category focus jump at the end of channel rails.
